description: Inspect or operate a NATIVE browser dialog that no extension can touch — the file picker, print dialog, basic-auth popup, or 'Leave page?'. action='list' shows the dialog's buttons; 'click_button' presses one by name (e.g. 'Open', 'Save', 'Don't Save'); 'set_text' types into the focused dialog field. macOS only; needs Accessibility permission.
name: browser_native_dialog
